description: Defines the gate that decides whether a previously-verified temp-workspace patch may be applied to the original repo. The gate itself performs NO write to the original repo — it returns an ApprovalGateDecision that the IDE/CLI consumer would honor under its own audited write path. Approval requires an ApprovalPacket that matches the VerifiedRepairTrace bit-for-bit on trace_id, workspace_identity, diff_sha256, verifier_status, and operator/approval_token. Any mismatch yields a specific SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED_* status. The accepted path is SOURCE_MUTATION_APPROVAL_ACCEPTED_FIXTURE — note the FIXTURE suffix: this rung does NOT admit live operator approvals; it only proves the decision logic.
purpose: Rung 5 of the verified-repair campaign. Pins the invariant that source mutation remains BLOCKED by default and can only be opened by a packet that references an exactly-matching verified trace. The next rungs (IDE state model, corpus guard, local model admission, readiness matrix, final state) compose against this gate; nothing in the apparatus ever writes to the user's original repo without a downstream consumer producing an ACCEPTED decision first.
approval_packet_required_fields: diff_sha256 (sha256 over unified diff; must match trace's safe_patch_result.unified_diff)
verifier_status (informational; gate uses the trace's value)
invariants: HumanApprovalGate.evaluate is a pure function — no I/O, no file write, no subprocess.

ACCEPTED requires ALL of: non-empty operator, non-empty approval_token, trace_id match, workspace_identity match, diff_sha256 match, verifier_status==PATCH_VERIFIER_PASSED_TEMP_ONLY, trace.final_status==TRACE_VERIFIER_PASSED_TEMP_ONLY, trace.source_unchanged_confirmed is True.
Any missing field or mismatch yields a specific SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED_* token.
source_mutation_authorized is False on every blocked decision and True only on SOURCE_MUTATION_APPROVAL_ACCEPTED_FIXTURE.
Verifier-failed trace cannot be approved (its diff is empty after rollback, AND its verifier_status != PATCH_VERIFIER_PASSED_TEMP_ONLY).
Unsupported-repo trace cannot be approved (no safe_patch_result; gate refuses on DIFF_MISMATCH or VERIFIER_NOT_PASSED).
scripts/repair/human_approval_gate.py and human_approval_record.py contain no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
Gate evaluation against any packet (valid or invalid) does NOT mutate the original fixture tree (sha256 before==after).
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
remaining_gaps: Live operator approval (non-fixture) is deferred. The accepted decision today is named SOURCE_MUTATION_APPROVAL_ACCEPTED_FIXTURE specifically so a future rung adding the live operator path can introduce a distinct ACCEPTED_LIVE token without breaking the closed set.

The actual original-repo write is NOT performed by this lock — only the gate decision. The IDE/CLI consumer of an ACCEPTED decision is responsible for the write under its own audited path (deferred to the IDE backend rungs).
Replay-attack protection (timestamp staleness, nonce, single-use token) is not enforced beyond the basic non-empty checks. A LIVE rung would add expiry + single-use semantics.
